{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_arm = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute number of responders and total patients
num_responders = treatment_arm['responded'].sum()
total_patients = len(treatment_arm)

# Compute fraction
fraction_responded = num_responders / total_patients

# Print only the numbers that will be in evidence
print(num_responders)
print(total_patients)
print(fraction_responded)"}
